# Comparison where the rest responds

<!-- Generated by tools/research/registry.py; edit the matching JSON record. -->

`comparison-where-the-rest-responds` · **recorded-checked** · theorem · F01 · [record](comparison-where-the-rest-responds.json) · [register](../../../../RESULTS.md)

> Where every formation outside a part responds through its couplings, two flows compare within its responsive reach: beyond it they are alike through the couplings, the part exchanges alike, and the difference never arrives; where only support couples in, the reach is the union of reach closures.

<a id="laws--规律"></a>
## Laws

1. Responsive reach: for two flows, two webs, a coupling by level (obs) and a part (a decided family of formations), a formation lies within the part's responsive reach when it lies within some member's closure under the relation ‘a exchanges, in one of the two flows, with a condition coupled into b’; every member lies within it, and what lies beyond is outside the part. (`Becoming.Flow.WithinResponse`, `Becoming.Flow.CoupledFromEither`, `Becoming.WithinClosure`, `Becoming.Flow.member_within_response`, `Becoming.Flow.outside_part_of_beyond_response`)
2. The closure under a converse is the converse of the closure, so a formation lies within the responsive reach exactly when some member lies within its coupling closure drawn through both flows; with one flow, exactly when some member lies within its coupling closure. (`Becoming.WithinClosure.converse`, `Becoming.Flow.withinResponse_iff_coupling`, `Becoming.Flow.WithinCoupling`, `Becoming.Flow.withinResponse_self_iff`)
3. What the part reaches and each member's reach closure lie within the responsive reach; with coupling by threshold only and one flow, a formation lies within it exactly when it lies within some member's reach closure; the reach closure is the converse of the influence closure. (`Becoming.Flow.withinResponse_of_reaches`, `Becoming.Flow.withinResponse_of_withinReach`, `Becoming.thresholdOnly`, `Becoming.Flow.withinResponse_thresholdOnly_iff`, `Becoming.WithinClosure.converse`)
4. The rest responds through its couplings when each formation outside the part, wherever the levels of the two webs have been alike through its couplings, under the first web, up to step t, takes from and gives to every condition alike in the two flows at step t; with the rest fixed (the second flow withholding the part) this holds whatever couples in. (`Becoming.Flow.RespondsThroughCoupling`, `Becoming.Web.AlikeThroughUpTo`, `Becoming.Flow.respondsThroughCoupling_withhold`)
5. The formations beyond the responsive reach form a region closed in both flows under being affected through what couples in, directly from the definition of the closure. (`Becoming.Flow.beyond_response_closed`, `Becoming.Flow.CoupledFrom`)
6. Confinement: where the two flows have the same formations present at every step, balance at each step on every condition coupled into a formation beyond the reach and start alike there, and the rest responds through its couplings, the flows are alike through every formation beyond the responsive reach at every step, and it exchanges alike with every condition (an instance of likeness within a closed region). (`Becoming.Flow.BalancesOn`, `Becoming.Flow.alike_beyond_response`, `Becoming.Flow.alike_within_closed`, `Becoming.Flow.exchange_alike_beyond_response`)
7. Under the same conditions, the totals the two flows take from and give to each condition coupled into such a formation are alike at every step, and the difference between the flows reaches it before no step. (`Becoming.Flow.totals_alike_beyond_response`, `Becoming.Flow.not_differs_beyond_response`, `Becoming.Flow.DiffersBefore`)
8. Where both flows balance, share the formations present, start alike and the rest responds through its couplings, for any significance covering from p every formation not beyond the responsive reach, the levels of the first web retain what has significance along those of the second exactly when they include them, and the reverse, and neither adds a continuation with significance exactly when neither exceeds the other. (`Becoming.Flow.Balances.comparison_within_response`, `Becoming.Flow.Balances.comparison_within_difference`)
9. The cover is double-negated because the difference shows only that a formation it reaches is not beyond the reach; where membership is decidable, covering the responsive reach suffices. (`Becoming.Flow.Balances.comparison_within_response_of_decidable`)
10. Witness, the trophic cascade: between the flow with the wolves and the flow in which the deer respond, the premise holds with coupling by threshold only, and the forest lies within the wolves' responsive reach, which their part does not reach. (`Becoming.Trophic.responds_through_coupling`, `Becoming.Trophic.forest_within_response`)
11. There the responsive reach is exactly the wolves, the deer and the forest; for any significance covering these three from p at every step, the two level paths retain along each other exactly as they include each other, and since each exceeds the other, neither retains. (`Becoming.Trophic.within_response_iff`, `Becoming.Trophic.responsiveReach_closed`, `Becoming.Trophic.far_unaffected`, `Becoming.Trophic.den_untouched`, `Becoming.Trophic.responsive_comparison`)
12. Witness, an escalation loop: two formations each require their own condition, which couples into it by level; in the flow with the act the first takes from the second's condition at step 0 and the second responds at step 1 by taking from the first's, while in the other flow nothing is taken; both flows balance, activity needs support, they start alike and the second responds through its couplings. (`Becoming.Loop.escalation`, `Becoming.Loop.quiet`, `Becoming.Loop.balances`, `Becoming.Loop.quiet_balances`, `Becoming.Loop.dependent`, `Becoming.Loop.quiet_dependent`, `Becoming.Loop.responds`)
13. There the first's own exchange with its condition is the same in both flows, yet with the act the first is unsupported at step 2 and without it supported; with the rest fixed the first's part does not reach the first, while the difference between the flows reaches it before step 2. (`Becoming.Loop.returns`)

<a id="conditions--条件"></a>
## Conditions

- Responding through the couplings (Flow.RespondsThroughCoupling) is a supplied premise in these laws, which use it only beyond the responsive reach; it excludes responding to what does not couple in, noise, and outside inputs not represented as conditions.
- Where the rest follows a law of exchange reading only what couples into each formation, the premise is a theorem for any two courses of the law (ExchangeLaw.Through.responds, counterfactual-is-the-course).
- Every law of what has stood reads through the coupling of everything, and with finitely many conditions through its sensitivity (ExchangeLaw.Nonanticipating.through_sensitive); with the law's sensitivity as the coupling those responses fall within it and the responsive reach widens.
- The hypotheses then still taken: the law of exchange itself; that it reads what has stood (ExchangeLaw.Nonanticipating); with the second flow the course another act generates, that course's feasibility (ExchangeLaw.Feasible, equivalent to its balance); and for the sensitivity form, finitely many conditions with decidable equality.
- The confinement laws assume balance at each step only on the conditions coupled into formations beyond the responsive reach (Flow.BalancesOn), the same formations present in both flows at every step, and a common start on those conditions.
- The main comparison assumes both flows balance throughout (Flow.Balances) and start alike; the significance sig is supplied, and the cover is double-negated, with no decision used; the decidable form takes the decision of the responsive reach as a hypothesis.
- A part is a decided family of formations; the responsive reach is drawn through both flows.
- For the trophic cascade and the loop: the witnesses' flows, webs and parts; the trophic flow in which the deer respond (Trophic.responsiveFlow, responsiveWeb) is the one the feedback laws supplied.
- Steps are counted from step 0; levels, needs and amounts are natural numbers. The axiom Unrestricted does not occur.

<a id="does-not-show--未表明"></a>
## Does not show

- Responding only through the couplings is supplied: neither that formations respond so nor how they respond follows here.
- The responsive reach is drawn through both flows, so it needs which conditions the second flow exchanges with; with the rest fixed it is drawn in the first flow, through Flow.withhold_exchanges, with no separate theorem here.
- The responsive reach is an upper bound: it does not say which formations within it the difference reaches, nor how much, and it is not ordered in time.
- The premise is stronger than what the laws use, which is only the exchange of formations beyond the reach on what couples into them.
- In the trophic cascade the responding flow is supplied and only checked against the premise.
- The loop is a minimal two-party witness (one act, one response, requiring and observing coinciding), not a general definition of a loop; no gain or runaway theorem is stated.
- **Counterexample:** The bound with the rest fixed is strictly smaller than the responsive reach: in the trophic cascade the wolves' part does not reach the forest, while the forest lies within the wolves' responsive reach (Trophic.forest_within_response) and the difference between the flows reaches it (Trophic.difference_reaches_forest). In Loop the difference returns to the part's own support, while the part does not reach itself (Loop.returns): the comparison with the rest fixed misses the loop. [source](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/Response.lean)
- **Counterexample:** The premise can fail: in Attracting nothing couples into the taker (it requires nothing, and only support couples in), yet it takes more where the stock is higher (Attracting.higher_breaks_first); by inspection, with no part, responding through the couplings fails there, and the confinement is not claimed. This module states no separate theorem for it. [source](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/Testing.lean)

**Standard boundaries:** No ethical premise and no Lean axiom is used. · Stated for discrete steps. · Names follow the structural naming criteria and are adopted only where the statement has their exact meaning; readings are interpretations, open to revision. · States how significance relates to structure, for any significance or under the continuation condition (Unrestricted: the continuation of anything has significance); it asserts no significance and does not assert the condition.

<a id="correspondence--对应"></a>
### Correspondence

After the AI compared the theory with a general cause–effect system (x_{t+1} = F(x_t, u_t, ε_t), feedback, adaptive parameters, attractors) and proposed five improvements, Ren wrote: “Great, let's finish all of them, you can spawn sub agents in a wise order if needed”. This is the second proposal, the AI's: the counterfactual where the rest responds, answering, for the case where the rest responds through its couplings, the chapter's open item “the counterfactual in which the rest of the exchange adjusts”. Readings (the AI's, adopted on Ren's delegation): an act has two counterfactuals, with the rest fixed, where only what the part reaches directly counts, and with the rest responding through its couplings, where the part's closure under affecting what couples in counts; what an act does to formations that interact with it is decided within the second; an escalation loop is the case where each party responds through its couplings and the difference returns to the part, which does not show in the comparison with the rest fixed; with coupling by threshold only, the responsive reach is the union of the reach closures, which gives the reach closure a counterfactual meaning: where the difference an act makes can arrive when the rest responds through its support. The cause–effect text pasted in the source, including its arms-race loop, has no stated author; it is not Ren's wording and not a premise of the theory.

It is not a general definition of a loop; it has one act, one response and one round, no gain or amplification, and no runaway theorem; the rest held fixed there is replaced here by responding through the couplings.
- related, not a proved adapter: [counterfactual-is-the-course](counterfactual-is-the-course.md). Derives this record's premise: where the rest follows a law of exchange reading only what couples into each formation, responding through the couplings is a theorem; the second flow is the course another act generates, so the comparison supplies neither the second flow nor the response; Loop.responds follows from the law (ExchangeLaw.Through.responds at Loop.replyLaw_through).
- related, not a proved adapter: [how-much-difference-arrives](how-much-difference-arrives.md). Answers two items of its next step: how much difference arrives is at most the carried amount, which is attained, and is positive exactly along a route in time of positive strengths (carried_pos_iff). Loops have witnesses only: a loop of strength one doubles a unit every step (Propagation.Loop.runaway).
- related, not a proved adapter: [how-a-carried-difference-grows](how-a-carried-difference-grows.md). Answers the item on loops in its next step, where the rest follows a law with given coupling strengths: a loop is a chain of couplings of positive strength back to where it started (OnLoop), the strength around it is one plus the product of its strengths, by which what reaches it is multiplied every time around (carried_runaway), and with the same formations and strengths at every step a polynomial bound holds exactly where no loop lies upstream.
